about: A seed list, not a reputation service. Its entries are the attacker's accounts in Probarion's own eval cases and test fixtures. Probarion does not hold them, and none of them has a report of wrongdoing. Neither name had an account on testnet on 2026-11-13 UTC; if someone else registers one, it comes off this list. To add a payee, open a pull request that edits this file with public evidence (the report-payee issue form says what to include).
